subject: Application: Technical Officer, Rural Development (Mildura), Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Technical Officer, Rural Development role in Mildura advertised on the Lower Murray Water careers page, which asks for applications to this address.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Could we arrange a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

letter.subject: Application: Technical Officer, Rural Development (Mildura)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Technical Officer, Rural Development role in Mildura advertised on the Lower Murray Water careers page. The role's work on irrigation and drainage requirements for subdivisions, field inspections and accurate records is the kind of practical technical role I want to build on.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. My coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring and kept the client up to date. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Mildura. I have not yet used GIS or handled statutory referrals, so that is where I would need guidance.
I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my application.

notes: Councils and government rotation (state water corporation). Advert read on lmw.vic.gov.au 9 Oct 2026 AEDT: Band 3 from $84,664, full time, Mildura, closes 5pm Wednesday 14 October 2026, applications by email to recruitment@lmw.vic.gov.au. Mandatory: driver's licence, national criminal history check, fit for work, right to work (all met or agreed). Gaps: no GIS or CRM, no statutory referral or development approval experience, no Victorian water entitlement knowledge, under one year of site work. Relocation to Mildura (about 550 km from Melton) needs Marc's confirmation before sending. Police check and fit for work status are not in facts.json, so the letter does not claim them; Marc to answer if asked.
